descriptionHtml:
Cushioned bolsters. Crate shape. Something to lean on inside four bars.

Ribble is a bolster dog crate bed with cushioned edges, a coated outer and a removable washable cover, in four sizes from 70 × 55cm to 105 × 75cm.

Watch where the head goes once they have finally settled. It goes over something. The lip of a cushion, the edge of a step, your foot if nothing better is available. A crate offers four flat bars and a flat floor, and there is nothing whatsoever in there to do that against.

Cushioned bolsters run round the edge of a padded middle, so the thing they were hunting for is already inside the crate when they get in.

What they get

  • Bolstered edges round a padded middle: A back, a hip or a chin gets something solid. You will see it used as a pillow far more often than as a fence.
  • A coated outer fabric: Paw prints and spills come off the outside without going near a machine.
  • A cover that comes off and washes: Machine washable for the days a cloth is not enough.
  • Four sizes, 70 × 55cm to 105 × 75cm: Enough steps to actually match a crate base or an estate boot.

Best for: dogs who sleep pressed against something, crates that double as the night-time bed, and the back of an estate car.

Why it is worth the money

The Small is £49, the Medium and the Large are both £79, and the XL is £99. That pricing is worth a second look. The Medium and the Large cost exactly the same, so if your crate takes the Large there is no reason at all to size down to the Medium.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

The bolsters are the reason to buy it and they are also what it costs you. They eat into the footprint, so 95 × 67cm on the Large is the outside of the bed and not the space your dog gets. Measure the crate to the bed, then measure the dog to what is left inside the edges.

Size and fit

SizeOutside (cm)What to know
Small70 × 55Smallest of the four
Medium85 × 6015cm longer than the Small
Large95 × 67Same price as the Medium
XL105 × 75The widest bolstered footprint

These are outside measurements and the bolsters take up some of that. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Wipe the coated outer for everyday marks. Check the sewn-in label before you wash the removable cover, because detergent and machine washing can affect some waterproof finishes.

A bed is a comfort accessory, not a vehicle restraint. Check crate fit without bunching or blocking access.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.
